neighbours.label: A pronoun-led independent clause following a comma splice
fire: The pressure in the tank is falling, this will interrupt the supply.
I noticed the clerk standing by the counter, I walked over to speak to her.
The researchers had collected all the samples, they were ready to begin.
The product attracted many buyers, it became the shop's best seller.
The heating system has stopped working, this will make the rooms colder.
The musicians had finished their rehearsal, they packed away their instruments.
The road was blocked by a fallen tree, it remained closed all afternoon.
I heard someone calling from the hallway, I opened the door to listen.
